notes.subject: n ka a ɲini
notes.rationale: תפלה 'ɲinikɛli, Ala-fɔli' — Bamanankan 'a ɲini' ka lasɔrɔ, nka tanaki-daɲɛ tɛ yen

notes.subject: i tulo di
notes.rationale: האזין 'ka tulo lase ka daminɛ' — Bamanankan fɛn-dilan 'tulo di' ka bɛn a la

notes.subject: שמע / האזינה
notes.rationale: kuma-fila-ka-sɔrɔ: 'mɛn' ni 'tulo di' — kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ fɔ a yɛrɛ kɔnɔ, sira-nsa don kele la

notes.subject: Elohim
notes.rationale: kɛlɛ-kɔrɔ kuma bɛ fɔ Elohim ma a yɛrɛ ma

translation: Elohim, n ka a ɲini mɛn; i tulo di n da kumaw ma.
